anchors.statement: The atm-bd-orchestration business logic must be in a single Python file.
anchors.quote: The business logic is to be in a single small python file which is organized by transition type and enums w/ exhaustive checks (that will compile error if not handled)
anchors.summary: Business logic in one Python file
anchors.scope: adds or changes atm-bd-orchestration close hooks, sanity-stack-link, assignment-gates.py, close-vars.py, close_fields.py or console dispatch code
anchors.deterministic_check: grep for bead/task/stack transition conditions outside the business-logic file finds none

anchors.statement: The atm-bd-orchestration transition business-logic file is organized into one section per transition type.
anchors.quote: The business logic is to be in a single small python file which is organized by transition type and enums w/ exhaustive checks (that will compile error if not handled)
anchors.summary: Business-logic file organized by transition type
anchors.scope: adds or changes atm-bd-orchestration close hooks, sanity-stack-link, assignment-gates.py, close-vars.py, close_fields.py or console dispatch code
anchors.deterministic_check: the business-logic file has one top-level section per transition-type enum member
